items.text: Fixed placement of floor decorations — they can now be placed in the alcohol production room
Fixed a bug that allowed collecting finished alcohol from multiple production stations into one box, causing some drinks to simply disappear
Fixed a bug that broke finished alcohol when trying to transfer it from box to box or from the player's basket to a box

releases.displayName: Major Update – Build Your Own Brewery!

notes.title: 🍾 The Biggest Liquor Store Simulator Update Is Here!

items.text: Hello everyone! We've prepared a brand-new update for you, and it's truly a massive one. Here's what's new:
Your store's assortment has been expanded with alcoholic beverages from different countries around the world. Diversify your shelves and surprise your customers!
We've added one more expansion for both the store and the warehouse. Now you'll have even more space to grow your business and store all your products.
Now you can not only sell alcohol—you can produce it yourself:
Beer
Wine
Moonshine
Liqueurs
Create your own unique alcoholic beverage! Come up with a name and design the label so your shelves feature something no one else has.
New colorful characters with their own preferences will visit your store. Try to satisfy them!
We've added weather effects and various events to make the game world feel more alive and dynamic.
We've refreshed the city's appearance, making the game world even more pleasant to explore.
A hippie has also wandered into town. For a small fee, he'll play the guitar and create a relaxing atmosphere.
For those who want to support us and receive some nice bonuses, we've released a new DLC:
🎵 100 tracks for the in-game music player
🖼️ New desktop wallpapers
✨ Additional decorative items for your store
Thank you for playing and supporting us—it truly means a lot! Leave your reviews and share your thoughts about the update. Your feedback is incredibly important to us! 🙌

releases.displayName: Update Announcement and New Game Demo Release

items.text: Hello everyone!

🍻 We're excited to announce that we've finished work on the biggest update ever for Liquor Store Simulator! We're currently testing the update extensively to provide the best possible gameplay experience without bugs or issues. The update is expected to be released at the end of July — there's not much longer to wait!
🍇 We won't reveal exactly what's coming in the update, but let's just say there will be another room and a lot of new content.

releases.displayName: New Year update and announcement of our new game!

notes.title: The Tovarishch Games team wishes everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

items.text: This year was very important for us, as we released our first game on Steam! Thank you to every player who played, left reviews, found bugs, and criticized us. Your support means a lot to us. Next year, we will continue supporting Liquor Store Simulator and release a new game! But more on that below — for now, here’s what we’ve prepared for you.
Winter has come to Liquor Store Simulator! Snow is falling outside, and all residents are wearing festive hats.
Snow and fog have been added to create a festive atmosphere (both effects can be disabled in the settings if they affect performance)
Customers now wear New Year hats
Neon signs now glow brighter
2 new garlands have been added to decorations
Added an “Updated Prices” category in the price change app — now it’s easy to find items whose prices changed today
Added the ability to enable or disable individual tracks in the music player
Added 8 new desktop wallpapers: 4 Halloween-themed and 4 New Year-themed
Added indicators for new items and equipment after purchasing upgrades
A very old bug that caused customers to freeze in front of shelves has finally been found and fixed
Fixed NPC navigation to shelves placed directly against walls
Fixed a bug where customers stopped buying draft beer
Fixed the number of beer kegs in the large refrigerator
Fixed an issue where the bartender sometimes didn’t take draft beer from the fridge
Renamed the setting for disabling copyrighted music
Minor optimization with a large number of shelves and items

We are happy to present our new game — Flip & Shop Simulator. It’s a cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a large open world. Dozens of different businesses — do what you enjoy the most:
sell goods in stores
cook food in restaurants
check documents
provide services
It’s literally all simulators in one game!
Add the game to your wishlist and see you in-game!

notes.title: The Store Has Grown! New Items, Mechanics, and Improvements

items.text: It’s been a few months since the last major update, and we haven’t been sitting idle! Meet v1.3.0 — a large-scale update that adds new content, improves visuals, and makes managing your store even more convenient.
Added new products: strong alcohol, plenty of new canned beers, energy drinks, and snacks
Added new licenses to expand your store’s assortment
Added new trade equipment: shelves and fridges with different designs
Added new decorations with category sorting for easier browsing
Added new decoration zones: now you can decorate the street in front of the store and the tables in the break room
Added new music tracks for atmosphere

Customers now look more realistic! They pick up baskets when entering the store, and at the checkout, their purchases are packed into branded bags. Small details that make a big difference — your store now feels even more alive!
Added a portable tablet — you can now manage orders and finances directly from the sales floor without running back to the computer
Added a draft beer fridge — accidentally poured the wrong bottle from the tap? No problem! Now you can store it in the fridge and use it later instead of throwing it away
Added eco-friendly recycling bins — throw away boxes, and the game will automatically sort them by type. Bonus: using eco bins gives you a small cash reward the next day!
Improved the draft beer purchase menu — it now shows how many bottles are in the fridges, as well as the number of full, partial, and empty kegs
Changed the cost and order of some licenses
Optimized the number of items in some snack boxes — no more extra units you can’t place anywhere
Fixed warehouse workers — they should no longer stop restocking certain products over time
Removed the annoying bell sound from self-checkout counters when an operator is active
Fixed an issue with incomplete window opening in the computer interface on low-end PCs

The game has been updated to a new engine version — optimization has been improved for smoother performance, but there’s a chance new bugs may appear. Please report them in our Discord or Steam discussions.
Thank you for your patience and support! We’ll keep working on new features and improvements — the next update is already in development!
Thank you for your continued feedback! We've released a new patch with various fixes and improvements:
Cashier and self-checkout operator now work slower at high fatigue instead of making errors
Cashier and self-checkout operator now only make errors at critical fatigue
Fixed an error where assistants moved at old speed instead of updated speed
Fixed incorrect display of loan data after loading when loan term differs from 15 days
Fixed shopping cart interaction with boxes in warehouse after loading a save
Fixed saving of boxes with expired orders under certain conditions
Added our logo when starting the game
We continue working on game stability and thank you for your patience!
Thank you to everyone who reported issues with box shelves after the 1.0.4 update!
We promptly investigated the situation and discovered a critical bug affecting the shelf functionality. This patch contains a fix for this issue. The shelves should now work correctly.

If you still encounter any strange behavior or inconveniences when working with shelves, please describe the situation in detail and, if possible, attach screenshots in the game's Steam community. This will help us identify and resolve the problem faster.
